definition: the fading light just before night
description: A calm forest lake in fading evening light, the sun already gone behind the pine treeline and the sky still warm orange. A man in green shorts leaps off the end of a wooden jetty and lands in the water with a ring of spray. More people then run down the jetty and throw themselves in one after another, each raising a burst of white splash, until several heads are bobbing in the dark water while the last daylight drains out of the sky.
